responsibility: Contains the machine-description scheduling model for AMD Zen-family processors znver1, znver2, and znver3 in GCC’s x86 backend. It defines the decode, integer, AGU, and floating-point automata and cpu units, then supplies detailed instruction reservations and latencies for scalar, SSE, AVX, load/store, branch, and call classes, including distinctions between Zen generations such as extra store AGU capacity, so the scheduler can model issue and pipeline timing for these AMD cores.
